Goal
Build a complete, standalone, 100% offline native Android app repository for https://github.com/terlingua/terlingua-android/ that packages the Books and Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) from https://github.com/terlingua/terlingua.github.io (content/books/ and content/authors/) into a fast, self-contained APK distributed via GitHub Releases and Obtainium (no Google Play).

Core Constraints

    Language & UI: 100% Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material 3 (plus themes matching terlingua.github.io: System, Light, Dark, Sepia, Solarized Light/Dark, High Contrast).

    Modern Stack & Latest Stable Dependencies: Use Gradle Version Catalog (gradle/libs.versions.toml) with current stable releases (AGP 9.x with built-in Kotlin—do not apply legacy org.jetbrains.kotlin.android—Kotlin 2.4+, Compose BOM, Navigation 3 or type-safe Compose navigation, Room + SQLite FTS5, kotlinx.serialization, Coroutines/Flow).

    SDK Support: minSdk = 26 (Android 8.0) for broad older-device compatibility; compileSdk = 36 (or 37) and targetSdk = 36.

    Zero Proprietary Dependencies & Zero Network: No Google Play Services, no Firebase, no analytics SDKs. Do not declare android.permission.INTERNET in AndroidManifest.xml. All book text, code highlighting, author info, and quizzes must be compiled into the APK at build time (ideally as a pre-populated SQLite DB with FTS5 full-text search in assets/).

    Content Pipeline: Keep content/books/ in terlingua.github.io unchanged. In GitHub Actions (and a local helper script), fetch terlingua/terlingua.github.io (sparse checkout of content/books, content/authors, and tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor if reusing it, or compile directly with a build tool) and bundle the compiled data into the Android build before assembling the APK.

Features Required

    Library, Search & Reader:

        Browse all books with chapter/section counts, reading time, tags, author card, and completion progress meter.

        Offline full-text search across books, chapters, and sections.

        Clean native rendering of Markdown prose, syntax-highlighted code blocks, blockquotes, and horizontally scrollable tables.

        Interactive single-answer (radio) and multiple-answer (checkbox) quizzes with immediate evaluation, retry, "show answer", explanations, and sticky answeredCorrectly progress matching terlingua.github.io (BookProgress schemaVersion 1).

    Adaptive UX (Phones, Foldables, Tablets, Notebook-style Android PCs):

        Use Material 3 Adaptive layouts (WindowSizeClass / ListDetailPaneScaffold) so tablets, unfolded foldables, and desktop/Chromebook windows show chapter TOC and content side-by-side.

        Full keyboard/mouse support (focus indicators, hover states, Esc/arrow navigation, smooth scrolling).

        Support Predictive Back and Edge-to-Edge across supported API levels.

    Button & Quiz Feedback (Visual + Audible + Tactile):

        Centralize interactive button/answer feedback so presses provide Material 3 visual ripple/scale feedback, device-capable haptic feedback (HapticFeedback / HapticFeedbackConstants), and optional bundled lightweight audio cues (SoundPool).

        Add Settings toggles to independently enable/disable Sound and Haptics, and respect the device's silent/DND state for audio.

    Offline Progress Backup & Sharing (Zero Server):

        Persist progress locally in Room/DataStore.

        Export/import a portable JSON file (.terlingua-progress.json, compatible with BookProgress schemaVersion = 1) via Android's Storage Access Framework (CreateDocument / OpenDocument) and Share Sheet (FileProvider + ACTION_SEND / ACTION_VIEW intent filters) so it works over messaging apps, email, Bluetooth, Syncthing, or local storage.

        Also support offline device-to-device transfer via QR code (single-book gzip+Base64 using open-source ZXing—no Play Services ML Kit) and/or local Wi-Fi/Hotspot (NsdManager + local socket).

        Imports must default to a conflict-free merge (OR answeredCorrectly, earliest firstVisitedAt, latest updatedAt) with a preview diff before applying, plus a Replace option.

CI/CD & Obtainium Distribution

    GitHub Actions workflow on push to main (plus workflow_dispatch):

        Fetch terlingua/terlingua.github.io content, compile book bundle, run unit + Compose UI tests, and build a single universal signed release .apk (not .aab, not ABI splits) with R8 minification enabled.

        Run PR checks (pull_request to main) that compile and test without publishing a release.

        Sign using these exact GitHub Secrets: KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD.

        Generate a strictly monotonic versionCode (e.g., from github.run_number) and date/run-based versionName.

        Publish a full GitHub Release (never pre-release) on every push to main, attaching the signed .apk and a .sha256 file, structured cleanly for Obtainium auto-updates.

Engineering & Output Expectations

    Follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, and unidirectional data flow (ViewModel + StateFlow).

    Keep code concise; avoid obvious/noisy comments (only add brief comments for non-obvious Android API/R8 constraints).

    Include complete README.md documentation covering local build steps, Obtainium setup (including how to record/pin the signing certificate SHA-256), and offline progress sharing.

    Deliver the full repository files cleanly with exact file paths (or generate all files directly in the workspace, and tell me if anything needs manual setup).

**Not yet.** Your prompt nails the product design, but as written it **does not guarantee** latest stable dependencies, latest GitHub Actions, or avoidance of deprecated APIs. In several places it leaves "escape hatches" that will cause an AI coding agent to generate older 2024–2025 defaults.

---

### 7 Gaps That Will Cause Stale or Deprecated Output

1. **`compileSdk = 36` / `targetSdk = 36` is behind current stable Android**
   * **Android 17 (API level 37)** reached stable in **June 2026**.
   * Leaving `36` in the prompt means the agent will skip Android 17 requirements like **mandatory large-screen resizability** (no orientation/aspect-ratio opt-out on displays ≥ 600dp), **default Certificate Transparency**, and **background audio hardening**.
   * **Fix:** Explicitly set `compileSdk = 37` and `targetSdk = 37`.

2. **Conflicting requirement: "No `INTERNET` permission" vs. "`NsdManager` local Wi-Fi transfer"**
   * Standard Android sockets (including LAN-only `NsdManager` + local TCP/HTTP) require `android.permission.INTERNET` at the OS level, **and** Android 17 (API 37) also requires the new **`ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK`** runtime permission for mDNS/`NsdManager`.
   * **Fix:** Decide up front:
     * If **zero `INTERNET` permission** is a hard rule, drop `NsdManager` and do offline transfer via **QR codes (ZXing) + Share Sheet (`FileProvider`) + SAF files** (which covers Bluetooth, Quick Share, Signal, Email, USB, and Syncthing with zero network permissions).
     * Or, if you want LAN Wi-Fi transfer, explicitly allow `INTERNET` + `ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK` (API 37).

3. **Room 2.x vs. Room 3.0 (`androidx.room` vs. `androidx.room3`)**
   * Saying `"Room + SQLite FTS5"` will cause almost every LLM to emit **`androidx.room` (2.x)**, which entered **maintenance mode** in 2026.
   * **Room 3.0 (`androidx.room3`, latest stable `3.0.3`)** is a Kotlin/coroutines-first rewrite under a new Maven group/package that drops `SupportSQLite`, drops `kapt`/Java annotation processing (KSP-only), and uses `androidx.sqlite` drivers.
   * **Fix:** Explicitly specify **Room 3 (`androidx.room3`, `3.0.x`)** with **KSP** (never `kapt`) and `androidx.sqlite` drivers.

4. **Navigation 2 escape hatch**
   * Saying `"Navigation 3 or type-safe Compose navigation"` gives the agent permission to fall back to Navigation 2 (`navigation-compose`).
   * **Navigation 3 (`androidx.navigation3`, `1.2.2` stable)** already supports typed deep links (`UriDeepLinkMatcher`, `DeepLinkRequest`) and `ResultEventBus`.
   * **Fix:** Require **Navigation 3 (`1.2.x`) only**.

5. **AGP 9.x is too broad & misses AGP 10 readiness**
   * Current stable is **AGP 9.5.x** (`9.5.1` / `9.5.2`) on **Gradle 9.9.2** (minimum Gradle `9.6.0`).
   * **AGP 10.0** (upcoming late 2026) will permanently remove the legacy Variant API (`applicationVariants`), `android.newDsl=false`, and `android.builtInKotlin=false`.
   * **Fix:** Explicitly mandate **AGP 9.5.x**, **Gradle 9.6+ / 9.9.2**, **Configuration Cache enabled**, **`androidComponents {}` Variant API only**, and **no `android.newDsl=false` / `android.builtInKotlin=false` opt-outs**.

6. **GitHub Actions versions aren't specified at all**
   * Without explicit minimums, LLMs routinely emit deprecated **`actions/checkout@v4`**, deprecated **`actions/setup-java@v4`** (v1–v4 are officially deprecated), deprecated **`gradle/gradle-build-action`**, or deprecated **`ubuntu-22.04`**.
   * **Fix:** Require current stable actions (`ubuntu-24.04`, `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/setup-java@v6`, `actions/setup-dotnet@v6` if running `ContentProcessor`, `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6`, `softprops/action-gh-release@v3`) and a **Dependabot** config for `gradle` + `github-actions` so future upgrades stay automatic.
   * *(Note: `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6` uses a proprietary caching provider by default unless you pass `cache-provider: basic`, which uses 100% MIT-licensed `actions/cache` — worth specifying if you want strict FOSS-only CI.)*

7. **No verification / anti-hallucination rule for version numbers**
   * Even when asked for "latest stable", an LLM without web/tool access can guess non-existent patch numbers. Tell it to verify versions if tools are available, or avoid alpha/beta/RC releases (`-alpha`, `-beta`, `-rc`) and note any version that needs checking.

```markdown
## Goal
Build a complete, standalone, 100% offline native Android app repository for `https://github.com/terlingua/terlingua-android/` that packages the **Books** and **Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)** from `https://github.com/terlingua/terlingua.github.io` (`content/books/` and `content/authors/`) into a fast, self-contained APK distributed via GitHub Releases and Obtainium (no Google Play).

## Core Constraints
- **Language & UI:** 100% Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material 3 (plus themes matching `terlingua.github.io`: System, Light, Dark, Sepia, Solarized Light, Solarized Dark, High Contrast).
- **Modern Stack & Latest Stable Dependencies (No Deprecated APIs, AGP 10–Ready):**
  - Use Gradle **9.9.2** (wrapper) and **AGP 9.5.x** with **Gradle Configuration Cache** enabled and a Gradle Version Catalog (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`).
  - Use AGP 9's built-in Kotlin and modern DSL strictly: do **not** apply `org.jetbrains.kotlin.android`, do **not** set `android.builtInKotlin=false` or `android.newDsl=false`, do **not** use `kapt` (use **KSP** only), and do **not** use the legacy Variant API (`applicationVariants`); use `androidComponents {}` and lazy `Provider` task wiring so the project is ready for AGP 10.
  - Use latest **stable** releases only (no `-alpha`, `-beta`, or `-rc`): Kotlin **2.4.x** (with `kotlin.plugin.compose` and `kotlin.plugin.serialization`), Compose BOM + Material 3 + Material 3 Adaptive, **Navigation 3** (`androidx.navigation3` 1.2.x—do not use Navigation 2), **Room 3** (`androidx.room3` 3.0.x with `androidx.sqlite` drivers and KSP—do not use legacy `androidx.room` 2.x), `kotlinx.serialization`, and Coroutines/`Flow`.
  - Do not invent patch versions: use verified current stable versions and mark any version that should be double-checked against Maven Central / Google Maven with a brief comment in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`.
- **SDK Support:**
  - `minSdk = 26` (Android 8.0) for broad older-device compatibility; `compileSdk = 37` and `targetSdk = 37` (Android 17).
  - Fully comply with Android 17 `targetSdk = 37` requirements: adaptive resizability on large screens (no orientation or aspect-ratio locks), Edge-to-Edge, Predictive Back, and background audio compliance.
- **Zero Proprietary Dependencies & Zero Network Permissions:**
  - No Google Play Services, no Firebase, no ML Kit, no analytics SDKs.
  - Omit `android.permission.INTERNET` and `android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK` completely from `AndroidManifest.xml`.
  - All book text, code highlighting, author profiles, and quizzes must be compiled into the APK at build time as a pre-populated SQLite database with FTS5 full-text search in `assets/`.
- **Content Pipeline:**
  - Keep `content/books/` and `content/authors/` in `terlingua.github.io` unchanged.
  - In GitHub Actions (and a local helper script), fetch `terlingua/terlingua.github.io` (e.g., sparse checkout of `content/books`, `content/authors`, and `tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor` if reusing it, or compile directly with a build tool) and bundle the compiled SQLite database into `app/src/main/assets/` before assembling the APK.

## Features Required
1. **Library, Search & Reader:**
   - Browse all books with chapter/section counts, reading time, tags, author card, and completion progress meter.
   - Offline FTS5 full-text search across books, chapters, and sections.
   - Clean native rendering of Markdown prose, syntax-highlighted code blocks, blockquotes, and horizontally scrollable tables.
   - Interactive single-answer (radio) and multiple-answer (checkbox) quizzes with immediate evaluation, retry, "Show answer", explanations, and sticky `answeredCorrectly` progress matching `terlingua.github.io` (`BookProgress` `schemaVersion = 1`).
2. **Adaptive UX (Phones, Foldables, Tablets, Notebook-style Android PCs):**
   - Use Material 3 Adaptive layouts (`WindowSizeClass` / `ListDetailPaneScaffold`) so tablets, unfolded foldables, and desktop/Chromebook windows show chapter TOC and content side-by-side and preserve state across fold/resize changes.
   - Full keyboard, mouse, and trackpad support (visible focus rings, hover states, Esc/arrow navigation, smooth scrolling).
3. **Button & Quiz Feedback (Visual + Audible + Tactile):**
   - Centralize interactive button and quiz answer feedback so presses provide Material 3 visual ripple/press feedback, device-capable haptic feedback (`LocalHapticFeedback` / `HapticFeedbackConstants`), and optional lightweight bundled audio cues (`SoundPool`).
   - Add Settings toggles to independently enable/disable Sound and Haptics, and respect the device's silent/DND state for audio.
4. **Offline Progress Backup & Sharing (Zero Server, Zero Network Permissions):**
   - Persist reading and quiz progress locally in Room 3 / DataStore.
```

## Goal
Build a complete, standalone, 100% offline native Android app repository for `https://github.com/terlingua/terlingua-android/` that packages the **Books** and **Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)** from `https://github.com/terlingua/terlingua.github.io` (`content/books/` and `content/authors/`) into a fast, self-contained APK distributed via GitHub Releases and Obtainium (no Google Play).

## Core Constraints
- **Language & UI:** 100% Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material 3 (plus themes matching `terlingua.github.io`: System, Light, Dark, Sepia, Solarized Light, Solarized Dark, High Contrast).
- **Modern Stack & Latest Stable Dependencies (No Deprecated APIs, AGP 10–Ready):**
  - Use Gradle **9.9.2** (wrapper) and **AGP 9.5.x** with **Gradle Configuration Cache** enabled and a Gradle Version Catalog (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`).
  - Use AGP 9's built-in Kotlin and modern DSL strictly: do **not** apply `org.jetbrains.kotlin.android`, do **not** set `android.builtInKotlin=false` or `android.newDsl=false`, do **not** use `kapt` (use **KSP** only), and do **not** use the legacy Variant API (`applicationVariants`); use `androidComponents {}` and lazy `Provider` task wiring so the project is ready for AGP 10.
  - Use latest **stable** releases only (no `-alpha`, `-beta`, or `-rc`): Kotlin **2.4.x** (with `kotlin.plugin.compose` and `kotlin.plugin.serialization`), Compose BOM + Material 3 + Material 3 Adaptive, **Navigation 3** (`androidx.navigation3` 1.2.x—do not use Navigation 2), **Room 3** (`androidx.room3` 3.0.x with `androidx.sqlite` drivers and KSP—do not use legacy `androidx.room` 2.x), `kotlinx.serialization`, and Coroutines/`Flow`.
  - Do not invent patch versions: use verified current stable versions and mark any version that should be double-checked against Maven Central / Google Maven with a brief comment in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`.
- **SDK Support:**
  - `minSdk = 26` (Android 8.0) for broad older-device compatibility; `compileSdk = 37` and `targetSdk = 37` (Android 17).
  - Fully comply with Android 17 `targetSdk = 37` requirements: adaptive resizability on large screens (no orientation or aspect-ratio locks), Edge-to-Edge, Predictive Back, and background audio compliance.
- **Zero Proprietary Dependencies & Zero Network Permissions:**
  - No Google Play Services, no Firebase, no ML Kit, no analytics SDKs.
  - Omit `android.permission.INTERNET` and `android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK` completely from `AndroidManifest.xml`.
  - All book text, code highlighting, author profiles, and quizzes must be compiled into the APK at build time as a pre-populated SQLite database with FTS5 full-text search in `assets/`.
- **Content Pipeline:**
  - Keep `content/books/` and `content/authors/` in `terlingua.github.io` unchanged.
  - In GitHub Actions (and a local helper script), fetch `terlingua/terlingua.github.io` (e.g., sparse checkout of `content/books`, `content/authors`, and `tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor` if reusing it, or compile directly with a build tool) and bundle the compiled SQLite database into `app/src/main/assets/` before assembling the APK.

## Features Required
1. **Library, Search & Reader:**
   - Browse all books with chapter/section counts, reading time, tags, author card, and completion progress meter.
